KEUG is the ICAO code for Mahlon Sweet Field (IATA EUG), located in Eugene, OR.

## Airport guide [...] Eugene Airport, also known as Mahlon Sweet Field, is a public airport 7 miles (11 km) northwest of Eugene, in Lane County, Oregon, United States. Owned and operated by the City of Eugene, it is the fifth-largest airport in the Pacific Northwest.

## Empty legs at airports near Mahlon Sweet Field [...] ## Airport guide

Mahlon Sweet Field (KEUG) sits 7 miles northwest of Eugene, Oregon. Of the two runways (8,009 ft, 6,000 ft), the longer is typically long enough for most heavy and super-midsize jets. Field elevation 365 ft, no density-altitude concerns. Eugene is home to the University of Oregon. Heavy fall football (Ducks) game-day peaks. Ground time to UO campus is 15 minutes; downtown Eugene is 15.
